--lua sim = require('sim')
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- FUSIONBOT MUJOCO COMPLETE SETUP -- -- Tip skripte: Customization script -- Pokrenuti dok je simulacija zaustavljena. --gvn -- Skripta ne mijenja masu, COM ili matricu inercije. ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local setupApplied = false
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- PUTANJE OBJEKATA ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local PATHS = { floor = '/Floor', base = '/mainBase_phy',
leftJoint = '/left_motor_joint', rightJoint = '/right_motor_joint',
leftWheel = '/left_motor_joint/leftWheel_phy', rightWheel = '/right_motor_joint/rightWheel_phy',
forceSensor = '/forceSensor', caster = '/forceSensor/frontCaster_phy' }
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GLAVNE POSTAVKE ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local CFG = { -------------------------------------------------------------- -- MuJoCo solver --------------------------------------------------------------
dynamicsStepSize = 0.002,
-- MuJoCo enum vrijednosti: -- integrator: 0 Euler, 1 RK4, 2 implicit, 3 implicitfast integrator = 2,
-- cone: 0 pyramidal, 1 elliptic cone = 1,
-- jacobian: 0 dense, 1 sparse, 2 auto jacobian = 0,
-- solver: 0 PGS, 1 CG, 2 Newton solver = 2,
iterations = 100, tolerance = 1.0e-10,
lineSearchIterations = 50, lineSearchTolerance = 0.01,
noSlipIterations = 10, noSlipTolerance = 1.0e-8,
ccdIterations = 100, ccdTolerance = 1.0e-8,
-- Tvr?e trenjske sile bez pove?anja koeficijenta trenja: impedanceRatio = 10.0,
-------------------------------------------------------------- -- Kontakt --------------------------------------------------------------
contactSolref = { 0.010, -- vremenska konstanta kontakta 1.000 -- relativno prigu?enje },
contactSolimp = { 0.950, 0.990, 0.001, 0.500, 2.000 },
floorFriction = { 0.80, -- klizno trenje 0.005, -- torzijsko trenje 0.0001 -- rolling trenje },
wheelFriction = { 1.00, 0.005, 0.0001 },
casterFriction = { 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 },
-------------------------------------------------------------- -- Pogonski zglobovi --------------------------------------------------------------
maxMotorTorque = 0.60,
-- Procjena dodatne inercije rotora/prijenosa. -- Za potpuno idealan motor mo?e biti 0. jointArmature = 2.0e-5,
-- Simetri?no suho trenje reduktora/zgloba [Nm]: jointFrictionLoss = 0.002,
-------------------------------------------------------------- -- Ostalo --------------------------------------------------------------
baseRespondable = false,
-- Skripta poku?ava automatski odabrati MuJoCo. selectMuJoCoEngine = true }
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- SIGURNO POSTAVLJANJE PROPERTYJA -- -- Neke starije verzije CoppeliaSima nemaju sve navedene properties. -- U tom slu?aju skripta ispisuje upozorenje i nastavlja dalje. ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local successfulSettings = 0 local failedSettings = 0
local function safeCall(label, callback) local ok, result = xpcall(callback, debug.traceback)
if ok then successfulSettings = successfulSettings + 1 return true, result end
failedSettings = failedSettings + 1
print( '[MuJoCo setup:warning] ' .. label .. ' nije primijenjen:\n' .. tostring(result) )
return false, nil end
local function setBool(target, propertyName, value) return safeCall( propertyName, function() sim.setBoolProperty( target, propertyName, value ) end ) end
local function setInt(target, propertyName, value) return safeCall( propertyName, function() sim.setIntProperty( target, propertyName, value ) end ) end
local function setFloat(target, propertyName, value) return safeCall( propertyName, function() sim.setFloatProperty( target, propertyName, value ) end ) end
local function setFloatArray(target, propertyName, value) return safeCall( propertyName, function() sim.setFloatArrayProperty( target, propertyName, value ) end ) end
local function setVector3(target, propertyName, value) return safeCall( propertyName, function() sim.setVector3Property( target, propertyName, value ) end ) end
local function listAllPaths() local function fullPath(h) local p = '' while h ~= -1 do p = '/' .. sim.getObjectAlias(h) .. p h = sim.getObjectParent(h) end return p end print('--- Objekti u sceni ---') for _, h in ipairs(sim.getObjectsInTree(sim.handle_scene)) do print(fullPath(h)) end print('-----------------------') end
local function getRequiredObject(path) local handle = sim.getObject(path, {noError = true}) if handle == nil or handle < 0 then listAllPaths() error('Nije prona?en objekt: ' .. path) end return handle end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- SCENE / GLOBAL MUJOCO POSTAVKE ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function configureScene() local scene = sim.handle_scene
setFloat( scene, 'dynamicsStepSize', CFG.dynamicsStepSize )
setVector3( scene, 'gravity', {0.0, 0.0, -9.81} )
-------------------------------------------------------------- -- Solver, integrator i kontaktni model --------------------------------------------------------------
setInt( scene, 'mujoco.integrator', CFG.integrator )
setInt( scene, 'mujoco.cone', CFG.cone )
setInt( scene, 'mujoco.jacobian', CFG.jacobian )
setInt( scene, 'mujoco.solver', CFG.solver )
setInt( scene, 'mujoco.iterations', CFG.iterations )
setFloat( scene, 'mujoco.tolerance', CFG.tolerance )
setInt( scene, 'mujoco.ls_iterations', CFG.lineSearchIterations )
setFloat( scene, 'mujoco.ls_tolerance', CFG.lineSearchTolerance )
-------------------------------------------------------------- -- NoSlip solver --------------------------------------------------------------
setInt( scene, 'mujoco.noslip_iterations', CFG.noSlipIterations )
setFloat( scene, 'mujoco.noslip_tolerance', CFG.noSlipTolerance )
setFloat( scene, 'mujoco.impratio', CFG.impedanceRatio )
-------------------------------------------------------------- -- Collision detection --------------------------------------------------------------
setInt( scene, 'mujoco.ccd_iterations', CFG.ccdIterations )
setFloat( scene, 'mujoco.ccd_tolerance', CFG.ccdTolerance )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.nativeccdEnable', true )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.multiccd', true )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.midphaseEnable', true )
-------------------------------------------------------------- -- Aktivni fizikalni podsustavi --------------------------------------------------------------
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.contactEnable', true )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.equalityEnable', true )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.frictionlossEnable', true )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.gravityEnable', true )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.limitEnable', true )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.passiveEnable', true )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.actuationEnable', true )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.sensorEnable', true )
-------------------------------------------------------------- -- Numeri?ka stabilnost --------------------------------------------------------------
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.warmstartEnable', true )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.refsafeEnable', true )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.eulerdampEnable', true )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.autoresetEnable', true )
-- Isklju?eno radi ponovljivosti rezultata: setBool( scene, 'mujoco.multithreaded', false )
-------------------------------------------------------------- -- Koristi mase i inercije zadane u CoppeliaSimu --------------------------------------------------------------
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.computeInertias', false )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.balanceInertias', false )
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.alignfree', true )
-------------------------------------------------------------- -- Pojedina?ni kontaktni parametri ostaju aktivni --------------------------------------------------------------
setBool( scene, 'mujoco.contactParamsOverride', false )
-------------------------------------------------------------- -- Bez strujanja zraka i fluidnih sila --------------------------------------------------------------
setFloat( scene, 'mujoco.density', 0.0 )
setFloat( scene, 'mujoco.viscosity', 0.0 )
setVector3( scene, 'mujoco.wind', {0.0, 0.0, 0.0} ) end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- ZAJEDNI?KE POSTAVKE SHAPE OBJEKATA ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function zeroInitialVelocity(handle) setVector3( handle, 'initLinearVelocity', {0.0, 0.0, 0.0} )
setVector3( handle, 'initAngularVelocity', {0.0, 0.0, 0.0} ) end
local function configureContactShape( handle, condim, priority, friction ) setInt( handle, 'mujoco.condim', condim )
setInt( handle, 'mujoco.priority', priority )
setFloatArray( handle, 'mujoco.friction', friction )
setFloatArray( handle, 'mujoco.solref', CFG.contactSolref )
setFloatArray( handle, 'mujoco.solimp', CFG.contactSolimp )
setFloat( handle, 'mujoco.solmix', 1.0 )
setFloat( handle, 'mujoco.margin', 0.0 )
setFloat( handle, 'mujoco.gap', 0.0 )
setFloat( handle, 'mujoco.gravcomp', 0.0 ) end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- PODLOGA ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function configureFloor(floor) setBool( floor, 'dynamic', false )
setBool( floor, 'respondable', true )
setBool( floor, 'kinematic', false )
setInt( floor, 'respondableMask', 65535 )
-- condim=1 na podu je namjerno. -- -- Kota? ima condim=3: -- max(1,3) = 3 -> standardno trenje. -- -- Caster ima condim=1: -- max(1,1) = 1 -> kontakt bez trenja. configureContactShape( floor, 1, 0, CFG.floorFriction ) end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- BAZA ROBOTA ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function configureBase(base) setBool( base, 'dynamic', true )
setBool( base, 'respondable', CFG.baseRespondable )
setBool( base, 'kinematic', false )
setBool( base, 'startInDynSleepMode', false )
if CFG.baseRespondable then setInt( base, 'respondableMask', 65535 ) else setInt( base, 'respondableMask', 0 ) end
zeroInitialVelocity(base)
-- Parametri nisu aktivni dok je baza non-respondable, -- ali se postavljaju za konzistentnost. configureContactShape( base, 1, 1, {0.0, 0.0, 0.0} ) end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- POGONSKI KOTA?I ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function configureDriveWheel(wheel) setBool( wheel, 'dynamic', true )
setBool( wheel, 'respondable', true )
setBool( wheel, 'kinematic', false )
setBool( wheel, 'startInDynSleepMode', false )
setInt( wheel, 'respondableMask', 65535 )
zeroInitialVelocity(wheel)
configureContactShape( wheel, 3, 10, CFG.wheelFriction ) end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- CASTER ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function configureCaster(caster) setBool( caster, 'dynamic', true )
setBool( caster, 'respondable', true )
setBool( caster, 'kinematic', false )
setBool( caster, 'startInDynSleepMode', false )
setInt( caster, 'respondableMask', 65535 )
zeroInitialVelocity(caster)
-- condim=1: -- samo normalna kontaktna sila, bez tangencijalnog trenja. configureContactShape( caster, 1, 20, CFG.casterFriction ) end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- MOTORNI ZGLOBOVI ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function configureMotorJoint(joint) setInt( joint, 'jointMode', sim.jointmode_dynamic )
setBool( joint, 'cyclic', true )
setBool( joint, 'enforceLimits', false )
setInt( joint, 'dynCtrlMode', sim.jointdynctrl_velocity )
-- Bez Ruckig profila za osnovni dinami?ki test: setInt( joint, 'dynVelMode', 0 )
-------------------------------------------------------------- -- MuJoCo specifi?ni parametri zgloba --------------------------------------------------------------
setFloat( joint, 'mujoco.armature', CFG.jointArmature )
setFloat( joint, 'mujoco.frictionLoss', CFG.jointFrictionLoss )
setFloatArray( joint, 'mujoco.frictionSolref', { 0.010, 1.000 } )
setFloatArray( joint, 'mujoco.frictionSolimp', { 0.950, 0.990, 0.001, 0.500, 2.000 } )
setFloatArray( joint, 'mujoco.limitsSolref', { 0.010, 1.000 } )
setFloatArray( joint, 'mujoco.limitsSolimp', { 0.950, 0.990, 0.001, 0.500, 2.000 } )
setFloat( joint, 'mujoco.margin', 0.0 )
-------------------------------------------------------------- -- Po?etno stanje motora --------------------------------------------------------------
safeCall( 'sim.setJointTargetVelocity', function() sim.setJointTargetVelocity( joint, 0.0 ) end )
safeCall( 'sim.setJointTargetForce', function() sim.setJointTargetForce( joint, CFG.maxMotorTorque ) end ) end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- FORCE SENSOR ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function configureForceSensor(forceSensor) -- Ne dopu?tamo automatsko pucanje veze: setBool( forceSensor, 'forceThresholdEnabled', false )
setBool( forceSensor, 'torqueThresholdEnabled', false )
-- Bez dodatnog ka?njenja o?itanja: setInt( forceSensor, 'filterSampleSize', 1 )
setInt( forceSensor, 'filterType', 0 ) end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- ISPIS MASE ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function printMass(name, handle) local ok, mass = pcall( sim.getFloatProperty, handle, 'mass' )
if ok and mass ~= nil then print(string.format( '%-15s mass = %.6f kg', name, mass )) end end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- ODABIR MUJOCO ENGINEA ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function selectMuJoCo() if not CFG.selectMuJoCoEngine then return end
safeCall( 'Odabir MuJoCo enginea', function() sim.setInt32Param( sim.intparam_dynamic_engine, sim.physics_mujoco ) end ) end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GLAVNA FUNKCIJA ----------------------------------------------------------------------
local function applyMuJoCoSetup() if sim.getSimulationState() ~= sim.simulation_stopped then error( 'Zaustavi simulaciju prije primjene MuJoCo postavki.' ) end
print('') print('==========================================================') print('FUSIONBOT MUJOCO COMPLETE SETUP') print('==========================================================')
local floor = getRequiredObject(PATHS.floor) local base = getRequiredObject(PATHS.base)
local leftJoint = getRequiredObject(PATHS.leftJoint)
local rightJoint = getRequiredObject(PATHS.rightJoint)
local leftWheel = getRequiredObject(PATHS.leftWheel)
local rightWheel = getRequiredObject(PATHS.rightWheel)
local forceSensor = getRequiredObject(PATHS.forceSensor)
local caster = getRequiredObject(PATHS.caster)
selectMuJoCo() configureScene()
configureFloor(floor) configureBase(base)
configureDriveWheel(leftWheel) configureDriveWheel(rightWheel)
configureCaster(caster)
configureMotorJoint(leftJoint) configureMotorJoint(rightJoint)
configureForceSensor(forceSensor)
-------------------------------------------------------------- -- Zavr?ni ispis --------------------------------------------------------------
print('') print('Mase nisu mijenjane:')
printMass('base', base) printMass('left wheel', leftWheel) printMass('right wheel', rightWheel) printMass('caster', caster)
print('') print(string.format( 'Dynamics step: %.6f s', CFG.dynamicsStepSize ))
print(string.format( 'NoSlip iterations: %d', CFG.noSlipIterations ))
print(string.format( 'Impedance ratio: %.2f', CFG.impedanceRatio ))
print(string.format( 'Wheel friction: %.4f', CFG.wheelFriction[1] ))
print(string.format( 'Caster friction: %.4f', CFG.casterFriction[1] ))
print(string.format( 'Maximum motor torque %.4f Nm', CFG.maxMotorTorque ))
print('') print(string.format( 'Primijenjeno postavki: %d', successfulSettings ))
print(string.format( 'Upozorenja/nepodr?ano: %d', failedSettings ))
print('==========================================================')
if failedSettings == 0 then print('STATUS: SUCCESS') else print( 'STATUS: ZAVRSENO UZ UPOZORENJA - ' .. 'provjeri gornji ispis.' ) end
print( 'Spremi scenu, zatim onemoguci ili ukloni ' .. 'customization script.' )
print('==========================================================') end
---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- CUSTOMIZATION SCRIPT CALLBACKS ----------------------------------------------------------------------
function sysCall_init() setupApplied = false end
function sysCall_nonSimulation() if setupApplied then return end
setupApplied = true
local ok, errorMessage = xpcall( applyMuJoCoSetup, debug.traceback )
if not ok then setupApplied = false
print('') print('==========================================================') print('MUJOCO SETUP ERROR') print('==========================================================') print(errorMessage) print('==========================================================') end end

--lua sim = require('sim')
local COMMAND_PROPERTY = 'signal.fusionbotMotorCommand' local COUNT_PROPERTY = 'signal.fusionbotMotorCallbackCount' local LAG_PROPERTY = 'signal.fusionbotLaggedCommand'
local OMEGA0 = 25 local TAU_STALL = 0.59999999999999998 local LAG_TAU = 0.050000000000000003 local DEADZONE = 0.059999999999999998 local C_FRICTION = 0.01 local B_FRICTION = 0.002
local laggedCommand = 0.0 local callbackCount = 0
local function clamp(v, lo, hi) if v < lo then return lo end if v > hi then return hi end return v end
local function sign(v) if v > 1e-12 then return 1.0 end if v < -1e-12 then return -1.0 end return 0.0 end
local function applyDeadzone(u) u = clamp(u, -1.0, 1.0) local m = math.abs(u) if m <= DEADZONE then return 0.0 end local r = (m - DEADZONE) / (1.0 - DEADZONE) if u < 0.0 then return -r end return r end
-- Pure function: identical to core.motor_model.MotorModel.update() function motorStep(command, omega, dt) local uDz = applyDeadzone(command) if LAG_TAU <= 0.0 then laggedCommand = uDz elseif dt > 0.0 then local a = 1.0 - math.exp(-dt / LAG_TAU) laggedCommand = clamp(laggedCommand + a * (uDz - laggedCommand), -1.0, 1.0) end local tauM = clamp(TAU_STALL * (laggedCommand - omega / OMEGA0), -TAU_STALL, TAU_STALL) local motion = sign(omega) if motion == 0.0 then motion = sign(laggedCommand) end local tau = tauM - C_FRICTION * motion - B_FRICTION * omega return clamp(tau, -TAU_STALL, TAU_STALL) end
function sysCall_init() laggedCommand = 0.0 callbackCount = 0 end
function sysCall_joint(inData) if inData.mode ~= sim.jointmode_dynamic then return nil end if inData.first then laggedCommand = 0.0 end local command = sim.getFloatProperty(inData.handle, COMMAND_PROPERTY, {noError = true}) if command == nil then command = 0.0 end local omega = inData.vel if omega == nil then omega = 0.0 end
local tau = motorStep(command, omega, inData.dt)
callbackCount = callbackCount + 1 if inData.passCnt == inData.totalPasses then sim.setIntProperty(inData.handle, COUNT_PROPERTY, callbackCount) sim.setFloatProperty(inData.handle, LAG_PROPERTY, laggedCommand) end
if math.abs(tau) < 1e-12 then return {vel = 0.0, force = 0.0} end local direction = 1.0 if tau < 0.0 then direction = -1.0 end return {vel = direction * OMEGA0, force = math.abs(tau)} end

--lua sim = require('sim')
local leftJoint local rightJoint local base
local lastPrintTime = -1.0 local stopRequested = false
------------------------------------------------------------ -- PARAMETRI VIRTUALNOG MOTORA ------------------------------------------------------------
-- Najve?i elektromagnetski moment pri mirovanju: local stallTorque = 0.60 -- Nm
-- Brzina bez optere?enja idealnog pogona: local noLoadSpeed = 25.0 -- rad/s
-- Ka?njenje motora i drivera: local motorTimeConstant = 0.05 -- s
-- Mrtva zona upravlja?ke naredbe: local deadZone = 0.06
------------------------------------------------------------ -- MEHANI?KI GUBICI POGONA ------------------------------------------------------------
-- Coulombovo trenje: local coulombFriction = 0.010 -- Nm
-- Viskozno trenje: local viscousFriction = 0.002 -- Nm*s/rad
-- Zagla?ivanje Coulombova trenja oko nulte brzine: local frictionSmoothingSpeed = 0.20 -- rad/s
------------------------------------------------------------ -- UNUTARNJA STANJA MOTORA ------------------------------------------------------------
-- Ovo su elektromagnetski momenti nakon ka?njenja. -- Mehani?ko trenje ra?unamo zasebno. local leftMotorTorque = 0.0 local rightMotorTorque = 0.0
------------------------------------------------------------ -- OGRANI?AVANJE VRIJEDNOSTI ------------------------------------------------------------
local function clamp(value, minimum, maximum) return math.max(minimum, math.min(maximum, value)) end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- HIPERBOLI?KI TANGENS -- -- U ovoj verziji Lua okru?enja funkcija math.tanh -- nije dostupna, pa je ra?unamo pomo?u math.exp. ------------------------------------------------------------
local function tanh(value) -- Za velike pozitivne vrijednosti tanh je prakti?no 1. -- Za velike negativne vrijednosti tanh je prakti?no -1. -- Ovim izbjegavamo prevelike vrijednosti u math.exp. if value >= 20.0 then return 1.0 elseif value <= -20.0 then return -1.0 end
local exp2x = math.exp(2.0 * value)
return (exp2x - 1.0) / (exp2x + 1.0) end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- MRTVA ZONA ------------------------------------------------------------
local function applyDeadZone(command) command = clamp(command, -1.0, 1.0)
if math.abs(command) <= deadZone then return 0.0 end
return command end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- TESTNI PROFIL -- -- 0-1 s: mirovanje -- 1-3 s: 30 % naredbe -- 3-7 s: coast uz mehani?ko trenje ------------------------------------------------------------
local function getTestCommand(time) if time < 1.0 then return 0.0 elseif time < 3.0 then return 0.30 end
return 0.0 end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- ?ELJENI ELEKTROMAGNETSKI MOMENT ------------------------------------------------------------
local function calculateDesiredMotorTorque( angularSpeed, effectiveCommand ) -- Kada nema naredbe, driver je u coast na?inu: if math.abs(effectiveCommand) < 1.0e-9 then return 0.0 end
local desiredTorque = stallTorque * ( effectiveCommand - angularSpeed / noLoadSpeed )
return clamp( desiredTorque, -stallTorque, stallTorque ) end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- KA?NJENJE AKTUATORA PRVOG REDA ------------------------------------------------------------
local function updateMotorTorque( currentTorque, desiredTorque, dt ) local alpha = 1.0 - math.exp( -dt / motorTimeConstant )
return currentTorque + alpha * ( desiredTorque - currentTorque ) end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- MEHANI?KO TRENJE ------------------------------------------------------------
------------------------------------------------------------ -- MEHANI?KO TRENJE ------------------------------------------------------------
local function calculateFrictionTorque(angularSpeed) -- Coulombovo trenje pribli?no je konstantno pri -- ve?im brzinama, a glatko prolazi kroz nulu. local coulombTorque = coulombFriction * tanh( angularSpeed / frictionSmoothingSpeed )
-- Viskozno trenje raste proporcionalno brzini. local viscousTorque = viscousFriction * angularSpeed
-- Dobiveni moment ima isti predznak kao brzina. -- U glavnom dijelu skripte oduzima se od -- elektromagnetskog momenta motora. return coulombTorque + viscousTorque end ------------------------------------------------------------ -- INICIJALIZACIJA ------------------------------------------------------------
function sysCall_init() leftJoint = sim.getObject('/left_motor_joint')
rightJoint = sim.getObject('/right_motor_joint')
base = sim.getObject('/mainBase_phy')
leftMotorTorque = 0.0 rightMotorTorque = 0.0
print('') print('Pokrenut test trenja motora i reduktora.') print('1-3 s: u=0.30') print('3-7 s: coast uz mehanicko trenje') end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- GLAVNI KORAK UPRAVLJANJA ------------------------------------------------------------
function sysCall_actuation() local time = sim.getSimulationTime()
local dt = sim.getSimulationTimeStep()
local command = getTestCommand(time)
local effectiveCommand = applyDeadZone(command)
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Trenuta?ne brzine kota?a --------------------------------------------------------
local leftSpeed = sim.getJointVelocity(leftJoint)
local rightSpeed = sim.getJointVelocity(rightJoint)
-------------------------------------------------------- -- ?eljeni elektromagnetski moment --------------------------------------------------------
local leftDesiredMotorTorque = calculateDesiredMotorTorque( leftSpeed, effectiveCommand )
local rightDesiredMotorTorque = calculateDesiredMotorTorque( rightSpeed, effectiveCommand )
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Ka?njenje elektromagnetskog momenta --------------------------------------------------------
leftMotorTorque = updateMotorTorque( leftMotorTorque, leftDesiredMotorTorque, dt )
rightMotorTorque = updateMotorTorque( rightMotorTorque, rightDesiredMotorTorque, dt )
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Mehani?ko trenje --------------------------------------------------------
local leftFrictionTorque = calculateFrictionTorque(leftSpeed)
local rightFrictionTorque = calculateFrictionTorque(rightSpeed)
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Kona?ni momenti na zglobovima --------------------------------------------------------
local leftNetTorque = leftMotorTorque - leftFrictionTorque
local rightNetTorque = rightMotorTorque - rightFrictionTorque
-- Sigurnosno ograni?enje: leftNetTorque = clamp( leftNetTorque, -stallTorque, stallTorque )
rightNetTorque = clamp( rightNetTorque, -stallTorque, stallTorque )
sim.setJointTargetForce( leftJoint, leftNetTorque, true )
sim.setJointTargetForce( rightJoint, rightNetTorque, true )
-------------------------------------------------------- -- Brzina baze --------------------------------------------------------
local linearVelocity = sim.getObjectVelocity(base)
local planarSpeed = math.sqrt( linearVelocity[1] ^ 2 + linearVelocity[2] ^ 2 )
-------------------------------------------------------- -- DIJAGNOSTI?KI ISPIS --------------------------------------------------------
if time - lastPrintTime >= 0.1 then lastPrintTime = time
print(string.format( 't=%4.2f | u=%+.2f | ' .. 'wL=%+6.3f motorL=%+6.3f frictionL=%+6.3f netL=%+6.3f | ' .. 'wR=%+6.3f netR=%+6.3f | ' .. 'vXY=%.3f', time, command, leftSpeed, leftMotorTorque, leftFrictionTorque, leftNetTorque, rightSpeed, rightNetTorque, planarSpeed )) end
-------------------------------------------------------- -- ZAUSTAVLJANJE TESTA --------------------------------------------------------
if time >= 7.0 and not stopRequested then stopRequested = true sim.stopSimulation() end end
------------------------------------------------------------ -- ?I??ENJE ------------------------------------------------------------
function sysCall_cleanup() if leftJoint ~= nil then sim.setJointTargetForce( leftJoint, 0.0, true ) end
if rightJoint ~= nil then sim.setJointTargetForce( rightJoint, 0.0, true ) end end

--lua sim=require'sim' -- FusionBot LiDAR scan script (installed by sim/lidar_setup.py, step 12b) local MAX_RANGE=5.0 local XYZD_PROPERTY='signal.fusionbotLidarXYZD' local COUNT_PROPERTY='signal.fusionbotLidarScanCount' local SCAN_DIVIDER=10 -- render + publish a scan every SCAN_DIVIDER-th step (10 Hz)
function sysCall_init() self=sim.getObject('..') visionSensors={sim.getObject('../sensor1'),sim.getObject('../sensor2')} local robot=sim.getObject('/FusionBot') local collection=sim.createCollection(0) sim.addItemToCollection(collection,sim.handle_all,-1,0) sim.addItemToCollection(collection,sim.handle_tree,robot,1) -- never see the robot itself for i=1,2 do sim.setObjectInt32Param(visionSensors[i],sim.visionintparam_entity_to_render,collection) sim.setObjectFloatParam(visionSensors[i],sim.visionfloatparam_far_clipping,MAX_RANGE) end for i=1,2 do sim.setExplicitHandling(visionSensors[i],1) -- rendered only when we ask end scanCount=0 stepCount=0 end
function sysCall_cleanup() for i=1,2 do sim.setExplicitHandling(visionSensors[i],0) end end
function sysCall_sensing() stepCount=stepCount+1 if (stepCount-1)%SCAN_DIVIDER~=0 then return end for i=1,2 do sim.handleVisionSensor(visionSensors[i]) end local data={} local invBase=sim.getMatrixInverse(sim.getObjectMatrix(self)) for i=1,2 do local r,t,u=sim.readVisionSensor(visionSensors[i]) if u then local m=sim.multiplyMatrices(invBase,sim.getObjectMatrix(visionSensors[i])) for j=0,u[2]-1 do for k=0,u[1]-1 do local w=2+4*(j*u[1]+k) local p=sim.multiplyVector(m,{u[w+1],u[w+2],u[w+3]}) data[#data+1]=p[1] data[#data+1]=p[2] data[#data+1]=p[3] data[#data+1]=u[w+4] end end end end scanCount=scanCount+1 sim.setFloatArrayProperty(self,XYZD_PROPERTY,data) sim.setIntProperty(self,COUNT_PROPERTY,scanCount) end

--lua sim=require'sim' -- FusionBot IMU script (installed by sim/imu_setup.py, step 12e) local G=9.81
local function mat(h) return sim.getObjectMatrix(h,sim.handle_world) end
function sysCall_init() self=sim.getObject('..') hist={} -- last three {t, matrix} count=0 logPath=sim.getStringProperty(sim.handle_scene,'customData.fusionbotImuLogPath',{noError=true}) logRows={} end
function sysCall_sensing() local t=sim.getSimulationTime() local m=mat(self) table.insert(hist,1,{t,m}) if #hist>3 then table.remove(hist) end local gyro={0,0,0} local acc={0,0,G} local valid=0 if #hist>=2 then local dt=hist[1][1]-hist[2][1] if dt>0 then local a,b=hist[2][2],hist[1][2] -- R(k-1), R(k): columns = axes -- Rrel = R(k-1)^T R(k); omega_body = vee(Rrel - Rrel^T)/2/dt local function R(M,i,j) return M[4*(i-1)+j] end local Rr={} for i=1,3 do Rr[i]={} for j=1,3 do local s=0 for k=1,3 do s=s+R(a,k,i)*R(b,k,j) end Rr[i][j]=s end end gyro={(Rr[3][2]-Rr[2][3])/(2*dt),(Rr[1][3]-Rr[3][1])/(2*dt),(Rr[2][1]-Rr[1][2])/(2*dt)} valid=1 if #hist>=3 then local c=hist[3][2] local dt2=hist[2][1]-hist[3][1] if dt2>0 then local aw={} for i=1,3 do local p0,p1,p2=c[4*i],a[4*i],b[4*i] aw[i]=((p2-p1)/dt-(p1-p0)/dt2)/(0.5*(dt+dt2)) end aw[3]=aw[3]+G -- specific force: a - g, g=(0,0,-G) acc={0,0,0} for j=1,3 do for i=1,3 do acc[j]=acc[j]+R(b,i,j)*aw[i] end end valid=2 end end end end count=count+1 sim.setFloatArrayProperty(self,'signal.fusionbotImuGyro',gyro) sim.setFloatArrayProperty(self,'signal.fusionbotImuAccel',acc) sim.setIntProperty(self,'signal.fusionbotImuCount',count) if logPath and logPath~='' then logRows[#logRows+1]=string.format('%.6f,%d,%.9g,%.9g,%.9g,%.9g,%.9g,%.9g', t,valid,gyro[1],gyro[2],gyro[3],acc[1],acc[2],acc[3]) end end
function sysCall_cleanup() if logPath and logPath~='' and #logRows>0 then local f=io.open(logPath,'w') if f then f:write('t,valid,gx,gy,gz,ax,ay,az\n') f:write(table.concat(logRows,'\n')) f:write('\n') f:close() end end end

--lua sim = require('sim') simZMQ = require('simZMQ')
local MOTOR_COMMAND_PROPERTY = 'signal.fusionbotMotorCommand' local COUNT_PROPERTY = 'signal.fusionbotMotorCallbackCount' local LAG_PROPERTY = 'signal.fusionbotLaggedCommand'
local LEFT_JOINT_PATH = '/FusionBot/left_motor_joint' local RIGHT_JOINT_PATH = '/FusionBot/right_motor_joint' local BASE_PATH = '/FusionBot/mainBase_phy' local ROBOT_PATH = '/FusionBot' local BASE_YAW_OFFSET = 1.5707963267948966
local STATE_ENDPOINT = 'tcp://127.0.0.1:23110' local COMMAND_ENDPOINT = 'tcp://127.0.0.1:23111' local PROTOCOL_VERSION = 2.0 local EVALUATION_DIVIDER = 1 local LOCKSTEP = true local LOCKSTEP_RECV_TIMEOUT_MS = 20 local LOCKSTEP_MAX_WAIT_S = 10.0 -- extension 2.1: IMU every step, every NEW LiDAR scan once (the scan script renders at 10 Hz) local IMU_PATH = '/FusionBot/mainBase_phy/FusionBotIMU' local LIDAR_PATH = '/FusionBot/mainBase_phy/fastHokuyo' local LIDAR_DIVIDER = 10 local lastStatePayload = nil local lockstepRepublishCount = 0 local lockstepReleased = false local gtYawRate = 0.0 local previousGtHeading = nil
local SENSOR_PATHS = { '/FusionBot/mainBase_phy/prox_left', '/FusionBot/mainBase_phy/prox_front_left', '/FusionBot/mainBase_phy/prox_front', '/FusionBot/mainBase_phy/prox_front_right', '/FusionBot/mainBase_phy/prox_right' }
local leftJoint = -1 local rightJoint = -1 local base = -1 local robot = -1 local sensors = {} local originalSensorEntity = {} local originalSensorExplicit = {}
local robotShapes = {} local visualShapes = {} local mazeWallSet = {} local mazeWallCollisionCollection = -1 local environmentCollection = -1
local VISUAL_SHAPE_ALIASES = { chassis_visual = true, name = true, rightWheel = true, rightWheelRim = true, leftWheel = true, leftWheelRim = true, }
local zmqContext = nil local statePub = nil local commandSub = nil
local stateSequence = 0 local sensingCount = 0 local lastAttachedLidarCount = 0 local evaluationSequence = 0
local appliedCommandSequence = 0 local appliedSourceStateSequence = 0 local appliedLeftCommand = 0.0 local appliedRightCommand = 0.0
local gtX = 0.0 local gtY = 0.0 local gtHeading = 0.0 local evaluationTime = 0.0 local leftCallbackCount = 0 local rightCallbackCount = 0 local leftLaggedCommand = 0.0 local rightLaggedCommand = 0.0
local stickyCollision = false local stickyCollisionRobotHandle = -1 local stickyCollisionWallHandle = -1 local stickyCollisionTime = -1.0 local stickyContactPoint = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0} local stickyContactForce = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0} local stickyContactNormal = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0}
local stickyVisualCollision = false local stickyVisualCollisionRobotHandle = -1 local stickyVisualCollisionWallHandle = -1 local stickyVisualCollisionTime = -1.0
local function clamp(v, lo, hi) if v < lo then return lo end if v > hi then return hi end return v end
local function wrapToPi(a) local twoPi = 2.0 * math.pi return (a + math.pi) % twoPi - math.pi end
local function buildEnvironmentCollection() local c = sim.createCollection(0)
sim.addItemToCollection( c, sim.handle_all, -1, 0 )
sim.addItemToCollection( c, sim.handle_tree, robot, 1 )
local templates = sim.getObject( '/FusionBot_templates', {noError = true} ) if templates ~= -1 then sim.addItemToCollection( c, sim.handle_tree, templates, 1 ) end
return c end
local function buildCollisionLookup() robotShapes = sim.getObjectsInTree( robot, sim.object_shape_type, 0 )
visualShapes = {} for i = 1, #robotShapes do local shape = robotShapes[i] local alias = sim.getObjectAlias(shape) local shortAlias = alias local p = string.match(alias, '([^/]+)$') if p ~= nil then shortAlias = p end
if VISUAL_SHAPE_ALIASES[shortAlias] then table.insert(visualShapes, shape) end end
mazeWallSet = {}
if mazeWallCollisionCollection ~= nil and mazeWallCollisionCollection >= 0 then pcall(sim.destroyCollection, mazeWallCollisionCollection) end
mazeWallCollisionCollection = sim.createCollection(1)
local handles = sim.getObjectsInTree( sim.handle_scene, sim.handle_all, 0 )
for i = 1, #handles do local alias = sim.getObjectAlias(handles[i]) local shortAlias = alias local p = string.match(alias, '([^/]+)$') if p ~= nil then shortAlias = p end
if string.sub(shortAlias, 1, 13) == 'FB_MAZE_wall_' then mazeWallSet[handles[i]] = true sim.addItemToCollection( mazeWallCollisionCollection, sim.handle_single, handles[i], 0 ) end end end
local function updateStickyCollision() if stickyCollision then return end
for i = 1, #robotShapes do local shape = robotShapes[i] local index = 0
while true do local pair, point, rForce, normal = sim.getContactInfo( sim.handle_all, shape, index )
if pair == nil or #pair < 2 then break end
local other = -1 if pair[1] == shape then other = pair[2] elseif pair[2] == shape then other = pair[1] end
if other ~= -1 and mazeWallSet[other] then stickyCollision = true stickyCollisionRobotHandle = shape stickyCollisionWallHandle = other stickyCollisionTime = sim.getSimulationTime()
if point ~= nil and #point >= 3 then stickyContactPoint = {point[1], point[2], point[3]} end if rForce ~= nil and #rForce >= 3 then stickyContactForce = {rForce[1], rForce[2], rForce[3]} end if normal ~= nil and #normal >= 3 then stickyContactNormal = {normal[1], normal[2], normal[3]} end return end
index = index + 1 end end end
local function updateStickyVisualCollision() if stickyVisualCollision then return end
if mazeWallCollisionCollection == nil or mazeWallCollisionCollection < 0 then return end
for i = 1, #visualShapes do local shape = visualShapes[i] local result, pair = sim.checkCollision( shape, mazeWallCollisionCollection )
if result ~= nil and result > 0 then stickyVisualCollision = true stickyVisualCollisionRobotHandle = shape stickyVisualCollisionTime = sim.getSimulationTime()
local wall = -1 if pair ~= nil and #pair >= 2 then if pair[1] == shape and mazeWallSet[pair[2]] then wall = pair[2] elseif pair[2] == shape and mazeWallSet[pair[1]] then wall = pair[1] end end
stickyVisualCollisionWallHandle = wall return end end end
local function updateEvaluation() evaluationTime = sim.getSimulationTime()
local pl = sim.getObjectPosition( leftJoint, sim.handle_world ) local pr = sim.getObjectPosition( rightJoint, sim.handle_world )
gtX = 0.5 * (pl[1] + pr[1]) gtY = 0.5 * (pl[2] + pr[2])
-- Physical forward = base local +Y. Its world direction is the second -- column of the 3x4 row-major matrix: (m[2], m[6], m[10]). local m = sim.getObjectMatrix(base, sim.handle_world) gtHeading = math.atan2(m[6], m[2])
local dtSim = sim.getSimulationTimeStep() if previousGtHeading ~= nil and dtSim > 0.0 then gtYawRate = wrapToPi(gtHeading - previousGtHeading) / dtSim else gtYawRate = 0.0 end previousGtHeading = gtHeading
local lc = sim.getIntProperty( leftJoint, COUNT_PROPERTY, {noError = true} ) local rc = sim.getIntProperty( rightJoint, COUNT_PROPERTY, {noError = true} ) local ll = sim.getFloatProperty( leftJoint, LAG_PROPERTY, {noError = true} ) local rl = sim.getFloatProperty( rightJoint, LAG_PROPERTY, {noError = true} )
if lc ~= nil then leftCallbackCount = lc end if rc ~= nil then rightCallbackCount = rc end if ll ~= nil then leftLaggedCommand = ll end if rl ~= nil then rightLaggedCommand = rl end end
-- extension 2.2 (step 14b): optional obstacle poses appended to the command packet -- [6] n, then n x (index, x, y, z): FB_MAZE_dyn_<index> moved to (x, y, z) in the world frame local dynHandles = {}
local function applyObstacles(values) if values == nil or #values < 6 then return end local n = math.floor(values[6] + 0.5) for i = 0, n - 1 do local b = 7 + 4 * i if #values < b + 3 then return end local h = dynHandles[math.floor(values[b] + 0.5)] if h ~= nil and h ~= -1 then sim.setObjectPosition(h, {values[b + 1], values[b + 2], values[b + 3]}, sim.handle_world) end end end
local function readLatestCommand() -- Drain all queued command messages. Only the newest command is applied. while true do local rc, data = simZMQ.recv( commandSub, simZMQ.DONTWAIT )
if rc == nil or rc < 0 or data == nil then break end
local values = sim.unpackDoubleTable(data)
if values ~= nil and #values >= 5 then if math.abs(values[1] - PROTOCOL_VERSION) < 0.1 then appliedCommandSequence = math.floor(values[2] + 0.5) appliedSourceStateSequence = math.floor(values[3] + 0.5) appliedLeftCommand = clamp(values[4], -1.0, 1.0) appliedRightCommand = clamp(values[5], -1.0, 1.0) applyObstacles(values) end end end end
local function readProximityPacked() local out = {}
-- The default CoppeliaSim main script already handles all non-explicit -- proximity sensors once per sensing pass, before simulation-script -- sysCall_sensing callbacks run. Read that result here instead of -- recomputing the same geometry with sim.checkProximitySensor. for i = 1, #sensors do local state, distance, point, objectHandle = sim.readProximitySensor(sensors[i])
if state ~= nil and state > 0 then table.insert(out, 1.0) table.insert(out, distance) if objectHandle ~= nil then table.insert(out, objectHandle) else table.insert(out, -1.0) end else table.insert(out, 0.0) table.insert(out, -1.0) table.insert(out, -1.0) end end
return out end
local function publishState() local proximity = readProximityPacked()
stateSequence = stateSequence + 1
local state = { PROTOCOL_VERSION, stateSequence, sim.getSimulationTime(), sim.getJointPosition(leftJoint), sim.getJointPosition(rightJoint), }
for i = 1, #proximity do table.insert(state, proximity[i]) end
table.insert(state, evaluationSequence) table.insert(state, gtX) table.insert(state, gtY) table.insert(state, gtHeading)
if stickyCollision then table.insert(state, 1.0) else table.insert(state, 0.0) end
table.insert(state, stickyCollisionRobotHandle) table.insert(state, stickyCollisionWallHandle) table.insert(state, leftCallbackCount) table.insert(state, rightCallbackCount) table.insert(state, leftLaggedCommand) table.insert(state, rightLaggedCommand)
table.insert(state, appliedCommandSequence) table.insert(state, appliedSourceStateSequence) table.insert(state, appliedLeftCommand) table.insert(state, appliedRightCommand)
table.insert(state, evaluationTime) table.insert(state, stickyCollisionTime)
table.insert(state, stickyContactPoint[1]) table.insert(state, stickyContactPoint[2]) table.insert(state, stickyContactPoint[3])
table.insert(state, stickyContactForce[1]) table.insert(state, stickyContactForce[2]) table.insert(state, stickyContactForce[3])
table.insert(state, stickyContactNormal[1]) table.insert(state, stickyContactNormal[2]) table.insert(state, stickyContactNormal[3])
if stickyVisualCollision then table.insert(state, 1.0) else table.insert(state, 0.0) end table.insert(state, stickyVisualCollisionRobotHandle) table.insert(state, stickyVisualCollisionWallHandle) table.insert(state, stickyVisualCollisionTime) table.insert(state, gtYawRate) table.insert(state, lockstepRepublishCount)
-- extension 2.1 table.insert(state, 1.0) local imuOk = false if imuHandle ~= -1 then local c = sim.getIntProperty(imuHandle, 'signal.fusionbotImuCount', {noError = true}) local g = sim.getFloatArrayProperty(imuHandle, 'signal.fusionbotImuGyro', {noError = true}) local a = sim.getFloatArrayProperty(imuHandle, 'signal.fusionbotImuAccel', {noError = true}) if c ~= nil and g ~= nil and a ~= nil and #g == 3 and #a == 3 then table.insert(state, c) for k = 1, 3 do table.insert(state, g[k]) end for k = 1, 3 do table.insert(state, a[k]) end imuOk = true end end if not imuOk then table.insert(state, -1.0) for k = 1, 6 do table.insert(state, 0.0) end end local scan = nil local lidarCount = -1 if lidarHandle ~= -1 then lidarCount = sim.getIntProperty(lidarHandle, 'signal.fusionbotLidarScanCount', {noError = true}) or -1 -- attach every NEW scan once (the LiDAR script renders at 10 Hz, step 13b-7) if lidarCount > lastAttachedLidarCount then scan = sim.getFloatArrayProperty(lidarHandle, 'signal.fusionbotLidarXYZD', {noError = true}) lastAttachedLidarCount = lidarCount end end table.insert(state, lidarCount) if scan ~= nil and #scan >= 4 then local n = math.floor(#scan / 4) table.insert(state, n) for k = 1, 4 * n do table.insert(state, scan[k]) end else table.insert(state, 0.0) end
local payload = sim.packDoubleTable(state) lastStatePayload = payload
-- PUB + DONTWAIT means simulator never waits for the external controller. simZMQ.send( statePub, payload, simZMQ.DONTWAIT ) end
local function applyCommandValues(values) appliedCommandSequence = math.floor(values[2] + 0.5) appliedSourceStateSequence = math.floor(values[3] + 0.5) appliedLeftCommand = clamp(values[4], -1.0, 1.0) appliedRightCommand = clamp(values[5], -1.0, 1.0) applyObstacles(values) end
local function waitForLockstepCommand() if lockstepReleased then return end local t0 = sim.getSystemTime() local lastSend = t0 while true do -- Non-blocking receive (same call as the validated V1.2 bridge), -- polled in a loop. No reliance on socket receive timeouts. local rc, data = simZMQ.recv(commandSub, simZMQ.DONTWAIT) local received = rc ~= nil and rc >= 0 and data ~= nil if received then local values = sim.unpackDoubleTable(data) if values ~= nil and #values >= 5 and math.abs(values[1] - PROTOCOL_VERSION) < 0.1 then local src = math.floor(values[3] + 0.5) if values[2] < 0.0 then -- RELEASE: controller finished; stop waiting so that the -- Remote API stopSimulation request can be served. lockstepReleased = true appliedLeftCommand = 0.0 appliedRightCommand = 0.0 return end if src == stateSequence then applyCommandValues(values) return end -- older command: stale duplicate, discard and keep waiting end else local now = sim.getSystemTime() if now - t0 > LOCKSTEP_MAX_WAIT_S then error('FusionBot lockstep: no command for state ' .. tostring(stateSequence) .. ' within ' .. tostring(LOCKSTEP_MAX_WAIT_S) .. ' s') end if lastStatePayload ~= nil and (now - lastSend) * 1000.0 >= LOCKSTEP_RECV_TIMEOUT_MS then lockstepRepublishCount = lockstepRepublishCount + 1 simZMQ.send(statePub, lastStatePayload, simZMQ.DONTWAIT) lastSend = now end end end end
function sysCall_init() leftJoint = sim.getObject(LEFT_JOINT_PATH) rightJoint = sim.getObject(RIGHT_JOINT_PATH) base = sim.getObject(BASE_PATH) robot = sim.getObject(ROBOT_PATH) imuHandle = sim.getObject(IMU_PATH, {noError = true}) lidarHandle = sim.getObject(LIDAR_PATH, {noError = true}) dynHandles = {} for k = 0, 15 do local h = sim.getObject('/FB_MAZE_dyn_' .. k, {noError = true}) if h ~= nil and h ~= -1 then dynHandles[k] = h end end if imuHandle == nil then imuHandle = -1 end if lidarHandle == nil then lidarHandle = -1 end
sensors = {} for i = 1, #SENSOR_PATHS do sensors[i] = sim.getObject(SENSOR_PATHS[i]) end
environmentCollection = buildEnvironmentCollection()
-- Preserve the previous sensor configuration, then make the default main -- script handle each sensor exactly once against our filtered environment. -- This keeps the old "scene minus FusionBot/templates" semantics without -- doing a second explicit detection in this bridge. originalSensorEntity = {} originalSensorExplicit = {}
for i = 1, #sensors do originalSensorEntity[i] = sim.getObjectInt32Param( sensors[i], sim.proxintparam_entity_to_detect ) originalSensorExplicit[i] = sim.getExplicitHandling( sensors[i] )
sim.setObjectInt32Param( sensors[i], sim.proxintparam_entity_to_detect, environmentCollection ) sim.setExplicitHandling( sensors[i], 0 ) end
buildCollisionLookup()
stickyCollision = false stickyCollisionRobotHandle = -1 stickyCollisionWallHandle = -1 stickyCollisionTime = -1.0 stickyContactPoint = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0} stickyContactForce = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0} stickyContactNormal = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0}
stickyVisualCollision = false stickyVisualCollisionRobotHandle = -1 stickyVisualCollisionWallHandle = -1 stickyVisualCollisionTime = -1.0
stateSequence = 0 sensingCount = 0 lastAttachedLidarCount = 0 evaluationSequence = 0
appliedCommandSequence = 0 appliedSourceStateSequence = 0 appliedLeftCommand = 0.0 appliedRightCommand = 0.0
sim.setFloatProperty(leftJoint, MOTOR_COMMAND_PROPERTY, 0.0) sim.setFloatProperty(rightJoint, MOTOR_COMMAND_PROPERTY, 0.0)
updateEvaluation()
zmqContext = simZMQ.ctx_new()
statePub = simZMQ.socket( zmqContext, simZMQ.PUB ) commandSub = simZMQ.socket( zmqContext, simZMQ.SUB )
-- Ensure cleanup never waits for queued network data. simZMQ.setsockopt( statePub, simZMQ.LINGER, sim.packInt32Table({0}) ) simZMQ.setsockopt( commandSub, simZMQ.LINGER, sim.packInt32Table({0}) )
-- Subscribe to all command messages. simZMQ.setsockopt( commandSub, simZMQ.SUBSCRIBE, '' )
local rcState = simZMQ.bind( statePub, STATE_ENDPOINT ) if rcState ~= 0 then error( 'FusionBot state PUB bind failed at ' .. STATE_ENDPOINT .. ', rc=' .. tostring(rcState) ) end
local rcCommand = simZMQ.bind( commandSub, COMMAND_ENDPOINT ) if rcCommand ~= 0 then error( 'FusionBot command SUB bind failed at ' .. COMMAND_ENDPOINT .. ', rc=' .. tostring(rcCommand) ) end end
function sysCall_actuation() if not LOCKSTEP then readLatestCommand() end
sim.setFloatProperty( leftJoint, MOTOR_COMMAND_PROPERTY, appliedLeftCommand ) sim.setFloatProperty( rightJoint, MOTOR_COMMAND_PROPERTY, appliedRightCommand ) end
function sysCall_sensing() sensingCount = sensingCount + 1
updateStickyCollision() updateStickyVisualCollision()
if sensingCount % EVALUATION_DIVIDER == 0 then evaluationSequence = evaluationSequence + 1 updateEvaluation() end
publishState()
if LOCKSTEP then waitForLockstepCommand() end end
function sysCall_cleanup() pcall( sim.setFloatProperty, leftJoint, MOTOR_COMMAND_PROPERTY, 0.0 ) pcall( sim.setFloatProperty, rightJoint, MOTOR_COMMAND_PROPERTY, 0.0 )
if statePub ~= nil then pcall(simZMQ.close, statePub) statePub = nil end if commandSub ~= nil then pcall(simZMQ.close, commandSub) commandSub = nil end if zmqContext ~= nil then pcall(simZMQ.ctx_term, zmqContext) zmqContext = nil end
-- Restore original proximity-sensor handling and detection targets before -- destroying the temporary filtered environment collection. for i = 1, #sensors do if originalSensorEntity[i] ~= nil then pcall( sim.setObjectInt32Param, sensors[i], sim.proxintparam_entity_to_detect, originalSensorEntity[i] ) end
if originalSensorExplicit[i] ~= nil then pcall( sim.setExplicitHandling, sensors[i], originalSensorExplicit[i] ) end end
